armD_note: The AGREEMENT point sits at xi ~ W/2 and moves with the window. It is a property of the fit, not of the chain. This REFUTES a claim already sent to a peer -- that the two methods calibrate each other somewhere inside the band -- and the refutation came from the same run, within the hour.
armC_note: Varying N at fixed window FRACTION moves the window and the finite-size scale together; at these masses xi = 1/m >> N for every N, so the chain length also sets the decay. Its near-flatness is UNEXPLAINED and supports nothing. The verdict rests on arm A, which holds the chain fixed and varies only which points are fitted.
verdict: WINDOW ARTIFACT CONFIRMED: the saturated ratio moves by 334.2% across fit windows on IDENTICAL data ({64: 3.3831749056401326, 128: 1.7188875260441694, 256: 0.7792330505974537, 384: 0.7792330505974537}). The 1.73 is a property of where the line was fitted, not of the chain. sqrt(3) is a coincidence of the N/4 window.
